intro: Fire-Roasted Corn from CAVA adds a smoky, sweet burst of flavor to any bowl or pita. This complimentary topping features charred sweet corn blended with peppers and lime, creating a vibrant addition to your meal. At just 45 calories, it delivers bold taste without compromising your nutrition goals. Explore the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) to discover more customization options.
priceCalories: Fire-Roasted Corn is included free with any CAVA order at 45 calories per serving. With 5g of carbs, 2.5g of fat, and 1g of protein, it adds flavor without significantly impacting your daily intake. This makes it an excellent choice for those watching their calorie count while building their perfect bowl. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to track your complete meal macros.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Fire-Roasted Corn apart is its unique charred preparation that caramelizes the natural sugars in sweet corn. The addition of peppers and lime creates a complex flavor profile combining smokiness, sweetness, and tangy brightness. This topping brings restaurant-quality taste to every bite while being completely complimentary. It transforms simple grain bowls into memorable meals across the [full CAVA menu](/).
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Fire-Roasted Corn contains 45 calories with a balanced macro profile of 1g protein, 5g carbohydrates, and 2.5g fat. The sweet corn provides natural fiber while the peppers add vitamins and antioxidants. The lime juice offers vitamin C without added sugars. This nutrient-dense topping enhances your meal nutritionally while keeping calories minimal for health-conscious diners.
whatsInside: Fire-Roasted Corn consists of charred sweet corn kernels mixed with colorful peppers and fresh lime juice. The corn undergoes a fire-roasting process that develops deep, caramelized flavors. Bell peppers add crunch and subtle sweetness, while lime juice brightens the overall taste. This simple yet expertly crafted combination uses whole food ingredients without artificial additives or preservatives.
tasteLike: Fire-Roasted Corn delivers a smoky-sweet flavor with citrus brightness from lime and a subtle pepper kick. The charring process creates caramelized notes that enhance the corn's natural sweetness. Each bite offers a satisfying crunch followed by juicy bursts of flavor. The peppers add mild heat and earthiness, while lime provides refreshing acidity that balances the richness perfectly.
customize: Add Fire-Roasted Corn to any creation from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or build your own combination. It pairs exceptionally well with any selection from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) including grains and greens. Layer it with other fresh toppings for texture variety. Consider adding it to pitas from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) for extra crunch.
pairsWell: Fire-Roasted Corn complements Shredded Romaine for added crunch and Tomato + Onion for fresh acidity. It works beautifully with Sumac Cabbage Slaw, creating a colorful vegetable medley. Pita Crisps add textural contrast when combined with the corn. The smoky flavors pair exceptionally with creamy options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like Crazy Feta or Hummus.
healthyChoice: At only 45 calories, Fire-Roasted Corn is a nutrient-smart topping choice for health-conscious diners. The corn provides complex carbohydrates and fiber for sustained energy. Peppers deliver vitamins A and C along with antioxidants. The minimal fat content and absence of added sugars make it ideal for various dietary approaches including low-calorie and balanced eating plans.
howToOrder: Select Fire-Roasted Corn when building your bowl or pita at the toppings station. Simply tell the team member you would like fire-roasted corn added to your order. It is included at no extra charge with any entree. For online orders, check the Fire-Roasted Corn option in the toppings section. Visit [CAVA Locations](/locations) to find your nearest restaurant.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Shredded Romaine at 5 calories, Fire-Roasted Corn offers more substantial flavor at 45 calories. While Tomato + Onion provides freshness at 20 calories, the corn delivers smoky depth. Pita Crisps contain 70 calories with more crunch, whereas Fire-Roasted Corn balances texture and taste. Sumac Cabbage Slaw at 30 calories offers tanginess while corn provides sweetness.
whoShouldTry: Fire-Roasted Corn appeals to anyone seeking bold, smoky flavors in their Mediterranean bowl. Vegetarians and vegans will appreciate this plant-based topping that adds substance without animal products. Health-conscious diners counting calories can enjoy flavorful meals guilt-free. Those exploring the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) will find this naturally gluten-free topping perfect for safe, delicious customization.
worthTrying: Fire-Roasted Corn absolutely deserves a spot in your next CAVA creation. The sophisticated flavor achieved through fire-roasting elevates simple ingredients into something special, all at no additional cost. With only 45 calories, you gain maximum taste impact with minimal nutritional trade-off. Its versatility across bowls, pitas, and salads makes it a topping worth experiencing repeatedly.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Fire-Roasted Corn?
faqs.a: CAVA Fire-Roasted Corn contains 45 calories per serving with 1g protein, 5g carbs, and 2.5g fat. This makes it a low-calorie topping option that adds flavor without significantly impacting your daily calorie goals.

faqs.q: Is Fire-Roasted Corn included free at CAVA?
faqs.a: Yes, Fire-Roasted Corn is included complimentary with any CAVA bowl, pita, or salad order. There is no extra charge for adding this topping, making it an excellent value addition to customize your meal.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Fire-Roasted Corn?
faqs.a: CAVA Fire-Roasted Corn contains charred sweet corn kernels, peppers, and lime juice. The corn is fire-roasted to develop smoky, caramelized flavors, then mixed with peppers for color and lime for brightness.

faqs.q: Is Fire-Roasted Corn at CAVA gluten-free and vegan?
faqs.a: Yes, Fire-Roasted Corn is both gluten-free and vegan, making it suitable for various dietary preferences. It contains only plant-based whole food ingredients without gluten-containing additives, perfect for those following restricted diets.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Fire-Roasted Corn taste like?
faqs.a: Fire-Roasted Corn has a smoky-sweet flavor with citrus brightness from lime and subtle pepper notes. The charring process caramelizes the corn's natural sugars while maintaining a satisfying crunch with juicy bursts of flavor in each bite.
